description: Convert a bytes/text column between common encodings: base64 (encode/decode), hex (encode/decode), text/bytes (utf-8). Drop-in for Alteryx Blob Convert tool.

outputs.description: Same shape; output_column populated with converted values

upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame
upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key

input_column.description: Column containing the input bytes / text
input_column.label: Input Column

operation.description: One of: to_base64, from_base64, to_hex, from_hex, to_text, to_bytes
operation.label: Operation

error_handling.description: How to handle conversion errors per row: 'coerce' (set None and log; default), 'raise' (fail asset).
error_handling.label: Error Handling
